g.text: Actual induced circuit: 6 populations ×16 Ca/LIF cells, plus6 graded inhibitory
Knee PF also supplies ankle MNs; it is not a separate ankle PF. External
afferent/commissural routes remain in the full216-pathway graph.
Double ring: spiking population (cell count shown). Open triangle: excitatory type;
filled circle: inhibitory. Current = g(Erev − Vpost).
